description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'git apply' command related to filename consistency checks. It sets up various patch files and verifies that the command behaves as expected when applying diffs with inconsistent or missing filenames.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, setting up patches and checking application results.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks if specific output exists within a command's output.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
